cohort: The study included 1972 obese women who underwent cesarean section.
finding: Prophylactic negative pressure wound therapy (NPWT) significantly decreased the risk of surgical site infection (SSI) in obese women undergoing cesarean section compared to standard dressing, but did not reduce overall wound complications or hospital readmission.
mod_finding: Prophylactic NPWT decreased the risk of SSI after cesarean section in obese women.
